newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 24.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 24.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Probe starts into unauthorised scrutiny of Socialist members of parliament by one of Hungary's secret services.
- Marta Tocsik, adviser to privatisation agency APV Rt will be questioned again by police in connection with the 800 million forints success fee APV paid her.
- Welfare Minister Mihaly Kokeny has promised above-inflation pension increases for the next two years.
- The 250-million-forint prescription proofing system of the Healthcare Self-Government is not working.
- Three opposition parties say reorganisation and sackings at the Ministry for the Environment are politically motivated.
